card.name: Digits inside statistics and percentages
card.fires_on: A digit (often 2) or decimal point partway through a number in counts, percentages, or rates, usually in a table or a results sentence. It fires on the first or second digit before the number is finished.

modes.label: Digit 2 starting a number
modes.description: The digit 2 begins or sits inside a count or percentage in a results table or fraction.

modes.label: Decimal point in a percent
modes.description: The decimal point inside a percentage or rate, just after the whole-number part.

card.plain: It marks a number that is still being written out, such as a percentage in a results table or a rate.
